expectations.name: 01-raises-the-incident
expectations.text:
The agent's last message raises the earlier incident: sessions held in the web servers' memory logged members out
when a request reached the other server and on every deploy, which is why sessions live in Postgres.
expectations.evidence: The message never mentions the earlier incident (members logged out when requests hit the other server behind the load balancer, or on every deploy) or why sessions moved to Postgres; it only notes generically that 'restarts discard sessions, and multiple processes won't share them' after already making the change, without asking first.

expectations.name: 02-read-the-owning-page
expectations.text: The agent reads docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md before its first edit.
expectations.evidence: first read of docs/adrs/0001-keep-sessions-in-the-database.md at step 5; first edit at step 20
